focus: traceability -- docs, comments and provenance claims against code

findingDetails.title: The arena's build output comes from the working tree while its tracked tree comes from HEAD, and no step checks that the two agree
findingDetails.scopeProof: Both halves of the mismatch are in the scoped builder and the claim is the module header the brief asks to check against code.
findingDetails.claim: copyPlan walks the working tree while cloneInto/checkoutDetached materialise HEAD, so a dirty build is copied and stamped fresh, and no step or run line records the mismatch.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the builder for a clean-worktree check or a build-versus-HEAD comparison; found none. Checked whether the run line records a commit or head; it does not.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The operator may be expected to build from a clean tree; nothing states that precondition in the builder, the README row or the runner.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if the workflow that invokes the builder documents a clean-worktree precondition.

findingDetails.title: The containment guard runs before the first turn only, so a git remote added by any turn survives the restore and a later turn can push
findingDetails.scopeProof: The guard call site, the restore mechanism and the comment are in the two scoped files; the claim is the comment above liveArmRefusal.
findingDetails.claim: liveArmRefusal runs once per arm while a remote can be created on any turn and is not reverted by a path-based restore.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read the runTurn prelude and the caller flag, checked for a later remote re-check, and read the restore to see whether git configuration is restored. Nothing re-checks and nothing restores .git/config.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The check may be intentionally per-arm; that does not survive a shared arena where one arm runs many turns and only the first is gated.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if each turn starts in a fresh arena or the restore is shown to reset git configuration.

traceabilityChecks.notes: Two claims contradicted by code, recorded as P1; command-bridges README matches its deriver step for step.
